economy.summary: His campaign site says inflation is severe and attributes it to federal mismanagement, opposes funding wars not voted on by Congress, and calls for prioritizing American sovereignty and opportunity over what it calls globalist policies.
economy.short: Attributes inflation to federal mismanagement; prioritizes American sovereignty.

taxes.summary: Pledges to seek property tax relief for seniors on fixed incomes and says legislators should cut their budgets when expenses rise, as homeowners must.
taxes.short: Pledges property tax relief for seniors; says legislators should cut budgets.

abortion.summary: Has described himself as pro-life; during his 2022 campaign he said he does not support a ban on abortion but suggested he would be open to one that includes exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother.
abortion.short: Describes himself as pro-life; open to ban with exceptions.

education.summary: His campaign site says schools should return to teaching reading, writing, and arithmetic rather than what it calls gender identity and CRT, and says parents' concerns about curriculum should not be silenced.
education.short: Supports back-to-basics curriculum; says parents' curriculum concerns matter.

energy.summary: Supports Pennsylvania natural gas extraction, which his campaign site describes as a clean energy source, and opposes battery and solar farms, citing fire hazards and mining concerns.
energy.short: Supports natural gas extraction; opposes battery and solar farms.

guns.summary: Said as a veteran and gun owner that he unequivocally believes in the Constitution's guarantee of citizens' ability to own firearms, and pledged to stand against attempts to restrict gun ownership in Pennsylvania.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment; pledges to oppose gun ownership restrictions.

economy.summary: Her campaign site says residents of southern Erie County deserve leadership that delivers more affordable housing and economic opportunities, and cites housing shortages as a problem she wants to address.
economy.short: Prioritizes more affordable housing and economic opportunities for residents.

education.summary: Her campaign site cites underfunded schools as a problem and emphasizes her work expanding rural access to education and workforce training in Northwest Pennsylvania, including through the Corry Higher Education Council and an autism education center she founded.
education.short: Cites underfunded schools; emphasizes expanding rural education access.
